correctness.rationale: Reconstructed plane-partition facet criterion: extreme matchings (0,0),(n,n) and diagonal (j,j) exhibit every proper face of chosen n+1 vertices while no matching contains all; this is an induced simplex boundary. Original published sequential x/y toggle matching has exactly one unmatched face tau={y,z_1,...,z_(n-1)}, and matched pairs cannot cross the specified induced core; hence the complete relative acyclic matching gives ordinary simplicial collapse K searrow L. Though this collapse order is not equivariant, the inclusion is equivariant and an integral homology isomorphism. Rotation swaps x,y and reverses z sequence, inducing permutation sign (-1)^(1+floor((n-1)/2))=(-1)^(n(n+1)/2); rational transfer yields mod-four invariant homology. Independently reconstructed facets, face counts and toggle matching for n=2,3,4: 1347,17487,206127 faces; explicit relative acyclicity topological sorting for n=2,3, with n=4 only complete pairing verified. Infinite acyclicity uses published general toggle lemma.
